contract.cleanup: Release all local and provider barriers, remove retained and borrowed handles, await tracked calls, dispose every owned handle in reverse order, verify local callback cohort counts and provider created/disposed equality, then delete per-case state. Supervisor tears down owned fleet after timeout or unknown cleanup.
contract.distinctness: Literal O012 state transition; counts, repetitions and deployment placements do not create additional cases.
contract.intent: Child capability returned by a target owns an independent lifetime from its parent
contract.oracle: Child lives after parent release; each target disposed once
preconditions: Parent can return separately allocated child
trace: Release parent and observe its single disposer
Invoke child and require it has no disposal yet
Release child; compare exact independent disposal counts

phase2_harness: five-process SeaweedFS fleet with separately witnessed recipient ownership
title: Child capability returned by a target owns an independent lifetime from its parent
